title: Bartholomew Street, St Montague Village, Lavender Hill (map point approximate): 16-year-old shot dead and 13-year-old wounded, 23 Nov
summary: A 16-year-old boy was shot dead and a 13-year-old wounded when two unidentified men walked into Bartholomew Street, St Montague Village, Lavender Hill, and opened fire at about 6.15pm on Monday 23 November, Western Cape ...
story: A 16-year-old boy was shot dead and a 13-year-old wounded when two unidentified men walked into Bartholomew Street, St Montague Village, Lavender Hill, and opened fire at about 6.15pm on Monday 23 November, Western Cape police spokesperson Lt-Col FC van Wyk told IOL. Voice of the Cape reports the same from police. IOL reports children were playing soccer in the street. Police believe the motive is gang-related; murder and attempted murder cases were opened and no arrests were reported. The children are not named. The map point is approximate: the Lavender Hill point, not the street.
incident: Mon 23 Nov 2026, about 6.15pm (SAPS, via IOL and Voice of the Cape)
